name: Uni
source:
Uni is a slice of life VN where you play as a young red-head woman who returns to school after some time off due to a personal tragedy.

You'll make decisions that decide what characters she becomes involved in, what club she joins, and what job that she gets to support herself.

[From [url=https://hizor.itch.io/uni]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Uni》是越南生活的一部分，你将扮演一名年轻的红发女子，由于个人悲剧而休假一段时间后返回学校。

你将做出决定，决定她参与哪些角色，加入哪个俱乐部，以及她得到什么工作来养活自己。

[来自[url=https://hizor.itch.io/uni]Itch.io[/url]]
